description: Improving Real-World Execution of Optimized Trading Schedules for Large-Scale Battery Storage Systems through Data-Driven Component Parametrization: Dataset is a data set deposited in RWTH Publications by its authors Mauricio Eduardo Celi Cortés, Lucas Koltermann (RWTH Aachen). This data set provides high-resolution measurement and optimization data from two field tests conducted on the M5BAT hybrid battery storage system in Aachen, Germany. Coverage: global (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
